preflight.referenceHarnessDifference: Frozen reference predates owned buffered-mode flags/report metadata and cold options validation. Actual shared warm driver, complete response checker, HTTP/native kernels and reference-specific code remain identical; full harness files are identical between source base/head.
preflight.scope: One fixed20-block affected source event, both Rust fixtures and bounded buffered response API. Complete final-head dual-compiler/platform CI remains required. The oversized-spill microvariant is separate, with no macro prefix or pooled timing. Workstation background applications and externally owned tests/builds remain uncontrolled and are explicitly recorded. No owned heavy work overlaps timing; no physical isolation or controlled release acceptance claim. Waiting for every foreign project to become idle cannot establish isolation and is not a requirement for this advisory event. This distinct32-pair event checks all Go root packages, affected LLGo validator/component/P3 packages and the nested P3 module; full final-head32-package LLGo matrix remains required. Prior16-pair complete timings and setup diagnostics stay in their original event.

macro.scope: Advisory fixed20-block affected P3 portfolio, all adverse observations retained. Independent 32-pair inline structural-comparison event; both sources use the bounded buffered response API and the same worker/read-ahead implementation. No source sweep or reused timed prefix. No pooling with earlier immutable-copy events. Default host policy, not controlled release acceptance. Go managed/LLGo collector bytes differ, and Go counters exclude Rust/JIT allocation. Native-Go is an ordinary application control, not an optimized native lower bound.
